name: Ristorante Picante
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ristorante Picante in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy restaurant in **Innsbruck** offers a warm atmosphere and delicious dishes, from fresh pasta to mouthwatering **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert.

Indulge in regional specialties like **Tiroler Gröstl** or enjoy our homemade **Speckknödel**—perfect with a glass of local **Graubündner** wine.

Whether you're craving a romantic dinner or a hearty meal after a day of skiing in the **Arlberg** or **Ötztal**, we’re your go-to spot.

**Come visit us and savor the flavors of Italy and Tirol!**
